Holds the items for a while, or until a time of day, then passes them on. The execution waits meanwhile without keeping anything busy, and carries on after a restart.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `logic.wait` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wait (`mode`) | text | no | `for` | for: a while. until: the next time the clock shows a time of day. One of `for`, `until`. |
| For (`for`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `10m` | How long, e.g. 30s, 10m or 2h. |
| Until (`until`) | text | no |  | A time of day in UTC, as HH:MM, e.g. 09:30. With mode until. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
